description: CHARACTERIZATION FIXTURE for saga #811 (issue #816): this locks TODAY'S DEFECTIVE behaviour, not the correct behaviour. It must be FLIPPED to the correct expectation when the #814 `[spec]` ruling lands and #815 implements it; the wall exists now so the fix is provably a change. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. `check()` half of the pair for the turtle form. `forward` is resolvable here because `turtle-rendering` is in this fixture's active profile set, so the only diagnostic is the real one on `wibble` — the same source under `core-language` alone would additionally flag `forward` itself, which is the false positive `profile-argument/` pins.
